name: Zenyte jewellery
description: Monkey Madness II, four zenyte shards, four onyx and the levels to craft and enchant all four pieces

children.note: Opens the Crash Site Cavern with the demonic gorillas and the wall of flame where zenytes are fused.
Fusing needs 70, cutting the zenyte and making the ring 89. Necklace 92, bracelet 95, amulet 98.
For the amulet of torture (amulet and stringing it). Skip it if you only want the other pieces.
Lvl-7 Enchant: 20 blood, 1 cosmic and 20 soul runes per cast.
1/300 from demonic gorillas. One per piece of jewellery.
TzHaar-Hur-Lek sells one for 300,000 tokkul (260,000 with Karamja gloves). Also Zulrah (2 × 1/1,024), Skotizo (1/1,000) and Zalcano (1/8,000). Cut it with 67 Crafting.
Zenyte amulet (98 Crafting), strung with a ball of wool, enchanted.
